description: Physical Pixel 7a attribution of remaining driving pauses, 2026-11-11. Full Chrome traces, profiles, source maps, probe records and build transform remain local under ignored data/scratch/driving-240/.

methodology: Same rebuilt production page, fixed clear road and 180 idle warm-up ticks. Two ordinary controls, two trace-only runs and two CPU+trace runs; each 30 seconds, no heap sampler. 1 ms CPU sampling. Cadence user-timing marks align trace/profile/page clocks exactly. Correlations are not automatic causal labels. Root GC uses main renderer thread only; CPU observations are timestamp-sorted to handle negative Chrome deltas, weighted as disjoint sampled wall-time intervals, not exact CPU time. Chromium thread-time counters can exceed wall durations and are retained only as reported, not used for conclusions. Raw browser traces may contain unrelated metadata and are not published.

probe.methodology: Same source except offCtx.getImageData(0,0,1,1) immediately after each terrain row, before the next budget check. Local transform only; working renderer unchanged. Both lanes wrap only native HTML canvas page copies, canvas uploads and one-pixel CPU reads; timing/bookkeeping overhead is instrumented.
probe.interpretation: All four 30-second probes qualify and copy the same 26 256x256 pages. A one-pixel read after each terrain row forces pending raster before the next builder deadline check; it moves cost out of later page-copy calls. Both CPU-request flags remain true. This confirms unaccounted deferred raster work, not that per-row reads are the optimal product fix. The local variant has no pixel-parity qualification and is not shipped. Startup/browser pauses remain separate.

conclusions: Repeated long rendering callbacks spend most sampled time in GpuPages.get -> Canvas2D drawImage, before GL texSubImage2D upload.
CPU-requested terrain canvases can defer raster work until copied; a submission-time budget does not account for completion cost.
No GC overlaps either captured missed trace-only interval, including their neighbouring-frame context. All recorded main-thread collections are minor; no natural major GC in these four captures.

The late trace-only-b miss overlaps a 46.245 ms Chromium memory_instrumentation.mojom.ClientProcess IPC. Its trigger is not established; do not attribute it to the game, GC or assume it occurs without diagnostics.
The 239 untraced 50 ms interval cannot be attributed retrospectively. The early 32.473 ms game callback remains incompletely attributed; CPU-profile captures did not reproduce a missed interval.
next: Budget completed terrain raster work during preparation, then validate pixel parity and device cadence/CPU tradeoffs. Keep browser IPC/startup pauses separate.
